info.title: Credit Card APIs
info.description: APIs for managing credit cards, including issuance, activation, limits, and transactions.

post.description:
Use this endpoint to replace a permanently blocked card for the same user (primary or supplementary/add-on). If the blocked card is a physical card, the replaced card will be delivered at the delivery address of the user. If you want to get it to a different address, please change the delivery address before polling this API.

**Note:**
Channel statuses and spend limits will  be reset for the replaced card to default.

oldCardId.description: The ID of the blocked card to be replaced.

cardId.description: The ID of the newly issued card.

400.description: Invalid request, bad input or missing fields.
